description.html:
Make mealtimes easier, healthier, and more delicious with our sleek 9L Stainless Steel Digital Air Fryer. Designed with families in mind, its generous single basket capacity is perfect for cooking larger portions-ideal for everyday dinners or entertaining guests.

Equipped with an easy-to-read digital LED display and soft-touch controls, it's never been simpler to select the perfect cooking settings. Choose from 10 one-touch preset menus including fries, wings, pizza, and roasts for quick, consistent results at the tap of a button.

The adjustable temperature range from 80 C to 200 C and 60-minute timer let you fine-tune your cooking for a wide variety of dishes. The smart pause function adds extra convenience-pause cooking by removing the basket and resume right where you left off once it's returned.

With a non-stick coated basket and dishwasher-safe parts, cleaning up is just as easy as cooking. Stylish, practical, and family-ready, this air fryer brings versatility and modern convenience to your kitchen.

9L Capacity
1800W
Digital LED display
Soft touch control panel
10 Preset Menus: Fries, Cake, Cookies, Peanuts, Shrimp, Steak, Chicken wings, Fish, Bacon, Pizza
Adjustable Temperature range 80 C ~ 200 C
Adjustable timer up to 60 minutes
Smart pause function
Non-stick coated cooking trays
Cool touch handles
Overheat safety protection with auto shut off
Non-slip feet
Operation light indicator
For domestic use only

What's in the box
1 x 9L Air Fryer
1 x Instruction manual
1 x Warranty information

## What does this mean?

You can pay for this item with cash when your driver delivers your order.

### How does it work?

Select Cash On Delivery (COD) as your payment option when you checkout.
Have the exact amount of cash ready for our friendly delivery driver when he arrives.

### Is COD available on every order?

No. We don’t offer COD for:

-   Digital products (e.g. eBooks, gift vouchers or airtime)
-   Customised products (e.g. a sports shirt printed with a personalised name)
-   Orders totalling less than R100 or more than R3,000
-   Orders being collected from Takealot pickup points
-   Delivery addresses falling outside of our Takealot Delivery Team area
-   Accounts that do not have a verified South African mobile number


### If your order is eligible for COD, it will be displayed as a payment option at checkout.
